review_basis.method: Independent needs-to-understand review against each tile's blocked_future_concepts and current glossary teaching scope. No generator reasoning or prior evaluator findings used; deterministic gates not rerun.

coverage.text_scope: All lesson and remediation text blocks, headings, ledes, visual labels, annotations, alt text and up-next text.
coverage.interaction_sample_fraction: 2 of 6 interactions (one third), including prompts, all options/items, bucket labels, feedback and hints. Additional interaction text encountered during lesson inspection was also checked for leakage.

tile_findings.rationale: AMI, supplied profile-attached role, temporary credentials, lifecycle state and status checks are explicitly within the current glossary facts. The lesson requires neither independent instance-profile/trust configuration nor health diagnosis. The S3 up-next sentence is a preview, not a dependency on understanding S3.

Bucket/key identity, copy direction, explicit profile and Region, and supplied caller-access and artifact-comparison evidence remain within the current teaching scope. Learners do not need to configure human credentials, evaluate policies, construct comparison commands, or understand versioning and lifecycle controls. The metric up-next sentence is a preview only.

Publication inputs and comparisons of complete metric identities are taught by this concept. Supplied values 7 and 3 do not require interpreting alarm thresholds, dimension costs, host-agent collection or telemetry-based health diagnosis.
